consumesExternalOutput.program: the turn-end hook the kernel generates (src/hooks.ts:38), plus the claude runs M4-P1 abandoned
consumesExternalOutput.provenance: The hook text is produced by calling renderTurnEndHook and written to the lab unmodified, so the exit-64 refusal this witness turns on is the shipped refusal rather than a restatement of it. The cited captures are M4-P1's real abandonment runs, which is what establishes that a turn ending with no exit code is a measured mode and not an invented one.
